title: Honeybee: Locality-enhanced Projector for Multimodal LLM
grouping: A thin top strip shows the whole model left to right (photo, vision encoder, a column of white ellipse features, projector, a column of yellow ellipse tokens, a wide language-model box with a row of yellow visual-token circles followed by blue text-token circles beneath it). A dashed leader drops from the projector box to a large pale-blue rounded panel below, split by dashed vertical lines into three alternatives, (a) linear projector, (b) abstractor, (c) the paper's locality-enhanced abstractors, each captioned beneath the panel.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded boxes with dark outlines; the strip's boxes are light grey, the projector pale blue. Features and tokens are small outlined ellipses: white for visual features, yellow-filled for visual tokens, blue-filled for text tokens. Inside the panel each variant draws a 2-D grid of ellipses passing through a tall narrow white box (text rotated 90°) into fewer yellow ellipses; (c) overlays grey square patches or yellow glows on the grid to show local neighbourhoods. The photo at the top-left is the only image.
proposed_highlight: Each variant is scored by two property lines under it: a satisfied property in bold green with a check mark, an unmet one in light grey with a cross. Only (c), the paper's design, has both lines green, and it occupies the widest third of the panel with two variants.
lesson: Zoom the one swappable connector box into a shaded panel below through a dashed leader, and score each variant with bold-green check / grey-cross property lines, so the paper's variant wins visually without a table.
notes: Token counts are shown by how many yellow ellipses leave each projector (a full grid vs. four). Venue from the arXiv comment ('CVPR 2024 camera-ready').

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: visual projector design for multimodal LLMs
taxonomy.note: a facet not in the vocabulary

insights.structure: A top row shows the generic MLLM pipeline (photo, Vision Encoder, Projector, Large Language Model), and a dashed line drops from Projector into a rounded tinted panel split by dashed dividers into (a) Linear Projector, (b) Abstractor, (c) Locality-enhanced Abstractor.
insights.data: Visual features are grids of hollow ellipses, output visual tokens are yellow ellipses, text tokens blue circles; C-/D-Abstractor show grey or yellow local neighbourhoods on the grid.
insights.emphasis: Each variant carries a check/cross list for Flexibility and Locality Preservation, and only (c) has both green checks.
insights.flow: Top row left to right; the zoom drops down; each sub-panel reads left to right from feature grid through a projector box to output tokens.

arrangement.units: a pipeline strip on top and below it one rounded tinted frame divided by dashed vertical lines into three captioned variant panels
arrangement.shared: the top pipeline is shared; only the projector varies across panels
